name: @loom/classify
description: Data-handling vocabulary for Loom — the sensitive()/secret()/internal() confidentiality markers + a schema walker, so a field is classified ONCE at its schema and every mechanism (crypto, redaction, egress) derives its wiring from that; plus the integrity axis (tainted()/unwrapTainted()), which attaches provenance to a VALUE at ingress because trustworthiness is not a property a schema can know. Kernel stays ignorant of both (G3).
